facts.text: The image is a composite creature reference sheet showing one dark dragon design: a large cinematic scene across the top, three labeled full-body view panels in the middle row, and four labeled close-up detail panels in the bottom row.

The large top image shows a black, heavily scaled, quadrupedal dragon with a long pair of pale horns, multiple head and neck spines, large membranous wings, and a long tail, positioned low on rocky ground beside shallow reflective water.
The background of the top image is a dark volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, a hazy sky, and warm orange ember or fire glow in the distance.
The middle row contains three full-body views: a front-facing view with wings spread, a side-profile view with the body extended and wings extended backward, and a rear-facing view with wings spread.

The bottom row contains four detail images: a close view of the horned head with a visible orange eye, a view of the dark veined wing membrane, a close view of a clawed foot with large curved talons, and a close view of overlapping dark scales with faint blue-green sheen.
Legible labels appear beneath the panels, reading FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The dragon’s design uses charcoal-black and slate-gray scales, bone-colored horns and claws, dark membranous wings, and small orange eye highlights.
The sheet has a dark-fantasy concept-art style, with cinematic lighting in the top scene and neutral dark backgrounds behind the isolated view and detail panels.

card.summary: A dark-fantasy dragon reference sheet combining one large cinematic scene with labeled front, side, and rear views plus close-up studies of the head, wing membrane, foot, and scales.

subjects.descriptor: Large black dragon with horns, spines, membranous wings, clawed feet, and a long tail
attributes: charcoal-black overlapping scales with faint blue-green sheen
long pale ridged horns swept backward
multiple spikes along the head, neck, and back
large dark membranous wings with visible veining

pose: top scene: crouched low on rocky ground with wings partly raised
front and rear views: standing with wings spread
side profile: body extended horizontally with wings extended backward
head close-up: head angled toward the viewer with one eye visible

card.environment: Volcanic rocky terrain with shallow reflective water, jagged crags, distant ember glow, and a dark hazy sky in the large top scene; the lower view and detail panels use plain dark backgrounds.
card.lighting: Low-key and moody, with the dragon mostly in dark shadow, pale horn and claw highlights, cool blue-green scale reflections, and warm orange ember light in the background.
card.framing: Composite reference-sheet layout: a wide hero image across the top, three full-body views in the middle row, and four detail panels in the bottom row, separated by thin dark dividers.
card.style: Dark-fantasy creature concept art and photorealistic digital painting with cinematic presentation.

limitations: The image is a still reference sheet and provides no evidence of motion, animation, camera movement, sound, music, or dialogue.
The dragon’s exact species, size, scale, and biological details cannot be determined from the image.
Some background and shadowed anatomical details are obscured by darkness and haze.
